header.title: Xiaobei Coach · Getting to know you

chat.greeting: Hi {name} — I'm Xiaobei, your career coach. I've got 8 quick questions to help me get to know you better.
chat.afterQuestions: That's all 8 questions — nice work. Now here's one more: if a career transition opportunity came your way right now, what would worry you most?
chat.freeChatDone: Got it — do you have a resume? Upload one and I'll analyze it for more precise advice.
chat.skipFreeChatAi: No problem! Last step — would you like to upload a resume so I can match you more precisely?
chat.resumeUploadedAi: Got your resume! I'll read it when I generate your report. Is there anything else you'd like to tell me?
chat.resumeFailedAi: Sorry, the resume upload ran into a network issue, so this report will be based only on your answers and background. Anything else you'd like to tell me?
chat.skipResumeAi: OK! Anything else you'd like to tell me?
chat.generating: Xiaobei is generating your personalized transition report…
chat.generatingBanner: Xiaobei is generating your transition report…

q1_decision.text: When making a work decision, what's your first instinct?
q1_decision.hint: Let's see whether you lead with logic or feeling.

options.a: Lay out the data and weigh the pros and cons, then decide
options.b: Ask the team and stakeholders first to build consensus
options.c: Trust my gut: decide fast and iterate fast
options.d: Think through the worst case first, then move carefully

q2_pressure.text: How do you usually handle deadline pressure?
q2_pressure.hint: What are you like under pressure?

options.a: Break the work into tasks and tick them off one by one
options.b: Sprint at the end — the more pressure, the better I perform
options.c: Pull the team together and divide the work
options.d: Re-rank priorities and cut what isn't essential

q3_communication.text: How do you usually behave when speaking in meetings?
q3_communication.hint: This reveals how you position yourself in conversations.

options.a: Prepare structured materials in advance and present them clearly
options.b: Listen first, then summarize and ask the key questions
options.c: Speak as ideas come — I like sparking ideas on the spot
options.d: Say little, but drop the core point when it matters

q4_rhythm.hint: What rhythm feels most comfortable to you?

options.a: Steady and predictable, with clear tasks and steps
options.b: Varied and challenging, moving forward one project wave at a time
options.c: Fast iteration — something new every day, but with clear goals
options.d: Deep, uninterrupted focus on one thing over the long term

q5_team.text: Which role do you play most often on a team?
q5_team.hint: This is the most direct question about your work style!

options.a: Driver: set goals and push everyone to deliver
options.b: Thinker: shape plans and strategy, set the direction
options.c: Coordinator: read the room and make sure everyone is heard
options.d: Executor: focus on doing my part to perfection

q6_change.text: If your company suddenly changed leadership or strategy, what would you do?
q6_change.hint: This shows how you react to uncertainty.

options.a: Look for a breakthrough immediately and draft a new plan of action
options.b: Analyze the logic behind the change and work out the new optimal path
options.c: Steady the team's mood first, then figure it out together
options.d: Assess the impact on me, prepare for the worst, then decide

q7_weekend.text: 🌿 With a completely free weekend and no plans, what would you most want to do?
q7_weekend.hint: Who are you outside of work?

options.a: Learn something new: tackle a demanding book or pick up a new skill
options.b: Explore: visit a shop I've never been to or wander somewhere unfamiliar
options.c: Meet friends: get a group together to eat, chat, and see people I've missed
options.d: Stay in and switch off: lie around, binge shows, plan nothing

q8_freeday.text: ✨ If you had tomorrow off from work and chores, how would you spend it?
q8_freeday.hint: Your most relaxed state reveals your core traits.

options.a: Get up early, make a plan, and work through it item by item
options.b: Jot down ideas or build a prototype — do something creative
options.c: Meet different friends and do something fun
options.d: Sleep in and let the day unfold however I feel
